tasks.short: Take disciplinary action for a performance problem

steps.what: Notice a performance problem while on the floor.
Read prior notes and the house rule before any disciplinary action.
Decide the disciplinary action that addresses the performance problem.
Tell the worker the disciplinary action face to face.
Write the warning wording and accept that exact text.
File only the accepted warning in the personnel record.

tasks.design: She still notices the problem, decides the disciplinary action, and tells the worker face to face. She writes the warning and accepts that wording. A separate step files only that accepted text in {HCM}. Nothing scores the worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: The warning was retyped into the personnel file after the talk, or it stayed on paper.
tasks.enabler_now: The personnel record can store the text she already accepted, as one file action.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the action, and saying it to the worker, stays a judgement about a person.
tasks.human_edge: She sees the work and she holds the conversation.
tasks.altitude: She still decides every disciplinary action and still says it face to face. The only shorter step is filing a warning whose wording she already accepted.

reach.task: hear a correction about a cut or colour that missed the brief
reach.learn: which words make the warning about the service the client received

evidence.claim: A personnel record can store a warning text she typed. The floor notice, the decision and the face-to-face talk are not shortened. Model knowledge.
WOR article 27(1)(b) and (l): a working and rest-time arrangement, and a time clock that can watch attendance or performance, need works council consent. This design adds neither.
EU AI Act annex III 4(b) applies if an AI tool allocates shifts based on individual behaviour or personal traits, or monitors staff performance. Filing text she wrote does not do that.

assumptions: s5 produces the warning fields s6 files: worker name, date, the performance problem in her words, the disciplinary action, and the house rule cited.
s6 commits only the version she accepted in s5. A change to the wording voids that acceptance.
If the record will not take the file, she keeps the same text on paper. That is why a month of verbal warnings saves less than the file share.
The re-read before she accepts the wording is already inside s5 and is not subtracted again.
Keeping the warning field list current takes about 1 hour per 100 baseline hours of this task.
No score, rank, camera or time clock is an input. Access days are for the personnel record, not for a monitoring tool.
unknowns: Whether every disciplinary action needs a written warning, or only when the house rule says so.
Whether today's warning lives in a personnel system, a paper file, or both.
research_questions: After the face-to-face talk, does she file a warning every time or only for a repeat problem?

already_counted.description: She re-reads the warning wording before she accepts it.

incremental.description: Warning field list, checked a few times a year.

approvals.approved_version: warning text she accepted in s5: worker name, date, performance problem, disciplinary action, house rule

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a month of verbal warnings, so she files nothing and still holds every talk. High: she files two accepted warnings and still holds every talk. One hour of field-list upkeep is already off the 8 point file share.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate a complaint and resolve it

steps.what: Hear the employee complaint before looking anything up.
Read the management regulations that govern this complaint.
Ask colleagues what they saw, without taking a side.
Decide how to resolve the complaint under the regulations.
Tell the people the resolution face to face.
Write the complaint resolution and accept that exact note.
File only the accepted complaint note in the personnel record.

tasks.design: She still hears the employee complaint, reads the regulations, asks what happened, and decides how to resolve it. She tells the people face to face, then writes the note and accepts that wording. A separate step files only that accepted note in {HCM}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The resolution note was rewritten into the personnel file after the talks.
tasks.enabler_now: The personnel record can store the note she already accepted, as one file action.
tasks.still_hard: People contradict each other. The resolution is still her judgement under the rules.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the complaint and she says the resolution.
tasks.altitude: She still investigates and still resolves the complaint in person. The only shorter step is filing a note whose wording she already accepted.

reach.task: take a guest complaint at the desk and note what was already said
reach.learn: which facts were given once, so she does not ask the employee to repeat them

evidence.claim: A personnel record can store a complaint note she typed. Hearing the complaint, asking colleagues, and telling them the resolution are not shortened. Model knowledge.
EU AI Act annex III 4(b) applies if an AI tool monitors staff performance or allocates shifts from individual behaviour or personal traits. This note is text she wrote, not that tool.

assumptions: s6 produces the note fields s7 files: who complained, date, what was said, the regulation applied, and the resolution in her words.
s7 commits only the version she accepted in s6. It is a different note from a disciplinary warning.
If the record will not take the file, she keeps the same note on paper. A week of verbal resolutions is why the low end is under the file share.
The re-read before she accepts the note is already inside s6 and is not subtracted again.
Keeping the note field list current takes about 1 hour per 100 baseline hours of this task.
No ranking of staff is produced. Colleague conversations are not messages sent outside the organisation.
unknowns: Which employee complaints she resolves herself, and which she must hand to HR.
research_questions: Does she file a note for every complaint, or only when the resolution changes someone's duties?

already_counted.description: She re-reads the complaint note before she accepts it.

incremental.description: Complaint-note field list, checked a few times a year.

approvals.approved_version: complaint note she accepted in s6: who complained, date, what was said, regulation, resolution

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a week she resolves every complaint in the room and files no note. High: she files one accepted note and still holds every talk. One hour of field-list upkeep is already off the 6 point file share.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe appearance and service on the floor

steps.what: Observe workers appearance and the quality of service.
Evaluate performance for compliance with the specifications.
Tell the worker what to correct in appearance or service.

tasks.design: She still observes appearance and service, evaluates performance against the specifications, and tells the worker what to correct. Nothing is scored, filmed or filed.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes the floor look or the correction.
tasks.still_hard: Judging whether the service met the specification still happens in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She sees the person and the client in front of her.
tasks.altitude: Her week on the floor does not change. She still observes, evaluates, and tells the worker what to correct.

reach.task: check a treatment room before a client sits down
reach.learn: which appearance points a client notices before the service starts

evidence.claim: Watching appearance and service, and telling the worker what to correct, stays on the floor and is not shortened. Model knowledge.
EU AI Act annex III 4(b) applies if an AI tool monitors staff performance. She evaluates the floor herself. No tool scores appearance or performance.

assumptions: Nothing is built, so incremental hours are zero. No step is shortened.
No camera, score, rank or time clock is added. Floor supervision stays with her.
unknowns: Whether the appearance and service specifications are written down or only habit.
research_questions: After she watches the floor, does she write anything down, or only speak to the worker?

incremental.description: No new upkeep, because nothing is built.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A day of floor checks is unchanged: she still observes appearance and service and still tells the worker. No step is shorter, so the saving is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: See which workers are on the floor and what is waiting.
Decide how to coordinate the next activities of the team.
Direct hair stylists or hotel staff what to do next.

tasks.design: She still sees who is free, decides how to coordinate the next activities, and directs stylists or hotel staff by speaking. Nothing is sent and nobody is scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: Nothing blocked speaking to the people on the floor.
tasks.still_hard: The next client and the next gap still change while she is standing there.
tasks.human_edge: She sees who is free and she says who takes the next client.
tasks.altitude: Her week of directing the floor does not change. She still coordinates the next activities and still tells the workers.

reach.task: turn the chair to the next waiting client
reach.learn: how a barber shows he is free so her direction matches the chair, not a shouted list

evidence.claim: Directing stylists or hotel staff stays a conversation on the floor and is not shortened. Model knowledge.
EU AI Act annex III 4(b) applies if an AI tool allocates shifts from individual behaviour or personal traits, or monitors staff performance. Speaking the next task is not that tool.

assumptions: Nothing is built, so incremental hours are zero. No step is shortened.
Telling a colleague what to do next is not a send outside the organisation. No roster is published from this task.
unknowns: Whether this workplace directs hotel staff, stylists, or both.
research_questions: Does she direct only by speaking, or does she also move names on a board?

incremental.description: No new upkeep, because nothing is built.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A busy floor day is unchanged: she still decides the next activities and still directs stylists or hotel staff. No message is sent, so the saving is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still holds the disciplinary talk, still hears complaints, still watches appearance, and still directs the floor. A written warning or a complaint note is filed only after she accepts the wording.
skills_to_grow: writing a warning that names the house rule and the date
hearing a complaint before deciding who is at fault
correcting appearance on the floor in one sentence
role.ambitious_version: She still decides every warning, complaint and floor correction herself. The only change is that an accepted warning or complaint note is filed once, from the wording she wrote.

job.title: First-Line Supervisors of Personal Service Workers
